build_HSwish_module: build a Hard Swish activation module using HSwish class with optional inplace parameter
create_HSwish_forward: create a forward pass through HSwish that computes x * ReLU6(x + 3) / 6
test_HSwish_inplace: test the HSwish module with inplace set to True for memory-efficient activation
review_ACTIVATION_LAYERS_registration: review the conditional registration of HSwish or nn.Hardswish in ACTIVATION_LAYERS registry based on PyTorch version
summarize_TORCH_VERSION_check: summarize the PyTorch version check that selects HSwish fallback for versions below 1.7
